'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Nathan Way DS Contract Killers''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nathan Way]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Day 2 Dark is the same as the Day 1 Contract Killers list.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy|VB8-D-contractkillers-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
